name: Wellhope Foods Co., Ltd.
summary: Wellhope Foods Co., Ltd. produces and sells feed products for swine, poultry, ruminant animal, and other animals in China and internationally. The company is involved in broiler breeding, hatching, feed production, commercial broiler breeding, broiler slaughtering and processing, and deep processing of prepared and cooked foods. It also engages in breeding and sales of breeding pigs, sales of commercial piglets, free-range fattening pig farming and a small amount of self-raising, and pig slaughtering; fish meal, soybean meal, and co-products of corn; and amino acid, antioxidant, mold inhibitors, and vitamins, and trades products, such as vaccines and veterinary drugs.
